question: What is something small at work that spiraled way out of control?
story: My boss held a two hour meeting about my email tone, and it ended with him losing his parking spot. The complaint was that I wrote per my last message too aggressively. Two hours. With a slideshow. He had built a slideshow. One slide compared my emails to a hostage note. So that night I read all one hundred and forty pages of the employee handbook, purely out of spite. Page ninety one said reserved parking is assigned by seniority and must be reviewed every quarter, and the results have to be posted. Nobody had reviewed it in nine years. I emailed HR about it very politely. I ended the email with per my last message. The review actually happened. His spot went to a woman in accounts payable who has worked there since two thousand four. He parks by the dumpsters now. He has never said one word about my tone again.
